input.change_text: Windows: Fixed bash command execution failing for users with `.bashrc` files

output.subject: Windows bash execution failed when user had a .bashrc file
output.action_text: Upgrade to 2.1.27+ on Windows if you have a `.bashrc` in your home directory. Pre-fix Bash tool calls failed outright for those users — full feature lost, no workaround beyond renaming the rc file.
